{{Quote|There, the Royal Script still graces the Palazzo Reina and other buildings dating to the rule of Queen Tasia, and is used on street signs in the capital's Old Quarter.|Doctor Milanda Vorgan, writing about Grizmallt in in "The Written Word"|<ref name="Written" />}}
The '''Old Quarter''' was a location within the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the<ref name="Written" /> [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmallt]]. Street signs in the Old Quarter were written in the [[Royal Script of Grizmallt]], an oval-based writing system. The Old Quarter was mentioned in the academic text "[[The Written Word: A Brief Introduction to the Writing Systems of Galactic Basic]]," written by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Milanda Vorgan]] and published in [[38 ABY]].<ref name="Written" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Old Quarter was mentioned in "[[The Written Word]]," an [[in-universe]] article written by [[John Hazlett]] and published on [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]], a subscription feature on [[StarWars.com]],<ref name="Written" /> on [[March 5]], [[2010]].<ref name="Pub date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/30796355|board=Literature|thread=Hyperspace New Short Fiction: JJM's "The Secret Journal of Doctor Demagol" now online!!!|user=[[Nathan O'Keefe|Valin_Kenobi]]|date=2010-03-05|time=12:25 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20171006225114/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/hyperspace-new-short-fiction-jjms-the-secret-journal-of-doctor-demagol-now-online.28297369/page-16}}</ref>
